sources.name: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)

opportunities.title: NAC Annual Project Funding 2026–2027
opportunities.description: Funding for individual arts practitioners, registered arts organisations and community art centres for the 2026–2027 financial year. Open to craft, dance, literature, music, theatre and musical theatre, visual arts, and multidiscipline arts.
opportunities.eligibility: South African individual arts practitioners, registered arts organisations and community art centres
opportunities.how_to_apply: Register and complete the online application form at https://nac.praxisgms.co.za/

opportunities.title: NAC Arts Organisation Support Funding (3-Year)
opportunities.description: Three-year support funding for registered arts organisations and companies in craft, dance, music, visual arts, literature, theatre and multi-discipline. Requires a three-year business plan.
opportunities.eligibility: Registered arts organisations and companies within the arts sector
opportunities.how_to_apply: Applications closed. Outcomes expected by 31 March 2026.

opportunities.title: Goethe-Institut Project Space (GPS) Grant 2026
opportunities.description: Seed funding for artistic projects realised in rural and peri-urban parts of South Africa, Lesotho and Eswatini between February and November 2026. Three projects will be selected.
opportunities.eligibility: Artists working in rural and peri-urban areas of South Africa, Lesotho or Eswatini

opportunities.title: Goethe-Institut International Co-production Fund (ICF)
opportunities.description: Supports co-productions worldwide arising from collaborative and dialogical work processes between professional artists in music, dance, theater and performance.
opportunities.eligibility: Professional artists in music, dance, theatre and performance collaborating internationally

opportunities.title: Presidential Employment Stimulus Programme (PESP 6)
opportunities.description: Government initiative for employment creation for artists, creatives, heritage sector workers and cultural workers. Supports creation, composition, workshops, showcases, exhibitions, script writing, residencies, performances, and other art-related activities.
opportunities.eligibility: South African arts and culture practitioners and organisations
opportunities.how_to_apply: Applications closed for 2025–2026 cycle. Projects must be concluded by 31 March 2026.

opportunities.title: National Lotteries Commission – Arts and Culture Sector
opportunities.description: Funds the development of the arts and the preservation of South African culture and national heritage, including natural environmental heritage, historical and architectural heritage. Empowers communities and enables artists to showcase work internationally.
opportunities.eligibility: South African registered non-profit organisations working in arts and culture
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply via the NLC portal at https://www.nlcsa.org.za/arts-and-culture/

opportunities.title: BASA Supporting Grants Programme
opportunities.description: Funded by the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture. Provides matching grants to support partnerships between business and the arts sector in South Africa.
opportunities.eligibility: Arts organisations with confirmed business sponsorship
opportunities.how_to_apply: Contact BASA at info@basa.co.za or visit www.basa.co.za

opportunities.title: Arts & Culture Trust (ACT) Development Grants
opportunities.description: ACT has served the arts and culture sector across all 9 provinces for 31 years through development and grant making. Founded in 1994 with support from Nedcor Bank and Sun International.
opportunities.eligibility: South African arts and culture practitioners and organisations across all 9 provinces
opportunities.how_to_apply: Visit https://act.org.za/ for current application information

opportunities.title: DSAC Bursary Programme 2026
opportunities.funder: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture
opportunities.description: Financial support for eligible South African students pursuing studies in sport, arts, heritage, and culture. Available for both undergraduate and postgraduate students.
opportunities.eligibility: South African citizens pursuing studies in sport, arts, heritage, or cultural studies

opportunities.title: NAC Local Postgraduate Bursary Programme 2026
opportunities.description: Supports emerging South African arts practitioners pursuing postgraduate qualifications at South African institutions.
opportunities.eligibility: South African arts practitioners enrolled or enrolling in postgraduate programmes

opportunities.title: DSAC Open Tenders
opportunities.funder: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture
opportunities.description: The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture regularly publishes tenders for service provision related to arts and culture infrastructure, programmes, and services.
opportunities.eligibility: Registered service providers meeting specific tender requirements

opportunities.title: The African Arts Trust Grants
opportunities.description: Grant making concentrated on Eastern and Southern Africa, supporting the development of arts across the continent.
opportunities.eligibility: Arts organisations and practitioners in Eastern and Southern Africa
